# fallcore-mcp

> An MCP server that gives an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf) eight tools for your own model: a FallCore proxy (local model first, frontier only on fallthrough, every call logged by the proxy) or plain Ollama. MIT.

## Canonical URL

https://sjgant80-hub.github.io/fallcore-mcp/

## Install

```
claude mcp add fallcore -s user --transport stdio -- npx -y github:sjgant80-hub/fallcore-mcp
```

It is not on npm. It installs from GitHub.

## Tools

- chat, models: work against a FallCore proxy or plain Ollama.
- health, stats, recent_logs: need the FallCore proxy (plain Ollama answers 404, and the tool says so).
- forge_stack, factory_tiers, factory_verticals: call the hosted FallCore Factory (https://fallcore-factory.onrender.com). These three are the only tools that leave your network unless your endpoint is remote.

## Checked

- Tests run every tool against a fake client, and the real server over stdio against a fake FallCore.
- witness kills all 37 mutants of src/core.js, with no exemptions (receipts/core-gate.json). Its fuzz battery finds no export that throws.
- CI runs all of it on every push.

## Does not

It does no thinking of its own and keeps no log of its own (the proxy does). It does not make any use compliant.
